notes: QR pairing: laptop ke Sidebar > Remote me samay chuno (15 min - 4 ghante), QR Dikhao dabao, phone se scan karo - connection sirf utne hi samay rahega, samay khatam hote hi band aur phone ke command bhi ruk jayenge. Mobile sidebar ab zyada chaudi aur aramdayak: bade text, 48px wale bade button, aur Lock/Logout neeche chipke hue - bina scroll kiye haath me.
